svg.title: The same doorway in the saved open and closed route states
svg.desc: Two source-derived grid plan crops use identical coordinates. The open saved route crosses the bedroom doorway. A source IFC door slab marks the closed condition; the retained scenario reports the bedroom-to-office pair disconnected. The closed occupancy mask itself is not available.
svg.text: A source door changes the stored route condition.
IFC DOOR BOUNDS / SAVED SCENARIO STATUS · CLOSED OCCUPANCY MASK NOT RETAINED
